'''Barthanes Damodred''' was [[High Seat]] of [[House Damodred]] and was cousin to [[Laman Damodred]].

== Appearance ==
He was slim, handsome and tall for a [[Cairhienin]], no more than half a head shorter than [[Rand al'Thor]] who is 6'6" or 198&nbsp;cm. He had black eyes and slightly greying hair. His voice is deep and sure. During the party Rand attends in Cairhien, he wears a deep grey coat with multihued stripes on the front from his neck almost to the hem just above his knees.{{ref/book|2|32}} These would likely be in House Damodred's red, green and white.{{ref/book|2|30}}

==History==
His personal seal is the charging boar.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Barthanes Damodred|comp}}

He was Laman Damodred's cousin.{{ref||comp}} His exact age is not known.

On Laman's death in {{ne|978}}, he became the High Seat of House Damodred.{{ref||comp}}

== Activities ==
Barthanes invites Rand to one of his parties{{ref/book|2|30}} and tries to find out where Rand's loyalties lie and if he supports King [[Galldrian Riatin]] and his project of digging up the male [[Choedan Kal]].{{ref/book|2|32}} He had a waygate within his estate. He was a [[Darkfriend]] and passes a message from [[Padan Fain]] to [[Rand]] about meeting each other on [[Toman Head]].{{ref/book|2|33}} He was found torn to pieces in his bedroom after the party at his house, presumably by the then unnamed ''[[gholam]]''.
